previous_development_split_reuse: All 100 old songs used to fit final fixed candidate. Original 25 are not a holdout for this refit.

hyperparameters.bliss_standardization: sklearn.StandardScaler fitted on OLD 100 songs only
hyperparameters.moodtheme_student_model: sklearn.Ridge(alpha=10.0) fitted on OLD 100-song native MoodTheme56
hyperparameters.inference_output: 56D pseudo-teacher predictions, L2 Euclidean pairwise distances

frozen_baselines: mean OLD 100 teacher per-class (constant MAE baseline)
metrics: out-of-cohort MAE of MoodTheme Ridge and Genre PLS against OLD-train-mean baseline
Spearman across all 28680 dependent song pairs: MoodTheme teacher Euclidean versus original Bliss Euclidean
Spearman across same 28680: MoodTheme teacher Euclidean versus train-only Ridge Bliss-student Euclidean
Spearman against Genre teacher Euclidean: original Bliss and student proxies (secondary, not self-target)
Spearman between pairwise original Bliss/student distances and Genre/Mood centered/embedding baseline dissimilarities (descriptive only)
inferential_limits: No musical similarity ground truth: Essentia teacher outputs are pseudo labels
No independent numeric Essentia parity certification; results are experimental
28680 pair distances share 240 songs and are not independent trials
New 240 tracks are artist/album/recording-disjoint only according to available LMS/Lab source identities
Unknown pretrained model overlap and mismatched audio or missing credits may remain
Do not tune or pick final metric based on this external teacher-proxy outcome; then claim untouched test
No new human ratings, queue changes, server or plugin changes
WP1 General Metric and WP2 optional Personal Metric are separate; neither is selected by pseudo teacher agreement
next_quality_gate: Separately consented preregistered blind human/external music-similarity comparison on a truly untouched cohort.
